nature: Current navigation and validation projection only. Not an operational register; confers no authority; PPV Potential throughout.

B1.name: Decision clarity
B1.meaning: The Steward can see current state, objective and next valid action without reconstruction.
B1.evidence: Cold-start walkthrough receipt; priority projection freshness stamp.
B1.realisation: A cold-start user reaches the correct next action from Home in under five clicks, verified by replay receipt.

B2.name: Delivery speed
B2.meaning: New Processes and Offerings move from idea to governed candidate without manual re-architecture.
B2.evidence: Candidate packet completeness check against the registry template; routing trace through the nine verbs.
B2.realisation: A complete candidate packet is produced through the start surface with all required fields and a verb-routing trace, no manual reconstruction.

B3.name: Assurance confidence
B3.meaning: Claims about state are evidence-bound; validation gates precede action.
B3.evidence: Test-matrix results filed with SHA-256 receipts; independent re-verification entries.
B3.realisation: All applicable automated assertions pass and are filed; disputed claims recorded as conflicts, not accepted.

B4.name: Asset compounding
B4.meaning: Qualified outcomes convert into reusable Patterns, Methods and Canonical objects instead of one-off narratives.
B4.evidence: Asset-qualification conditions recorded per candidate; Steward qualification decision reference.
B4.realisation: An outcome is only labelled an Asset after meeting written qualification conditions under Steward authority; until then it is recorded as candidate evidence.

B5.name: Governance integrity
B5.meaning: Authority boundaries, STOP/HOLD states and PPV discipline remain visible and enforced on every route.
B5.evidence: Authority and HOLD blocks rendered on every surface; registry authority fields; held-item register.
B5.realisation: No surface implies an unauthorised mutation; every held action is labelled HOLD with the holding authority named.

elements.name: Service Catalogue
elements.role: the governed register of what SynapSys offers: Services, their scoping fields, PPV state and catalogue lineage

mesh.enters: New Service ideas, Offering demands, coverage gaps and scoping defects arriving from any lane.
mesh.interprets: Whether a demand maps to an existing Service, a variant, or a genuine catalogue gap.
mesh.structures: Six-field scoped Service records and their MECE placement in the catalogue.
mesh.validated_by: Scoping validator checks, MECE coverage review and Steward catalogue acceptance.
mesh.action: Publish or amend catalogue entries as governed candidates; route Offering composition to Compose.
mesh.observes: Usage of Services in Offerings and the coverage gaps candidates reveal.
mesh.learns: Which scoping patterns survive assurance and which recur as defects.
mesh.asset_conversion: Stable Service definitions and scoping patterns qualify toward the Pattern and Method libraries.
mesh.feedback_to: Coverage and defect findings feed back to Orient as new Signals for the next catalogue cycle.

elements.assets: Service definitions, scoping templates and the MECE coverage model are the reusable assets this Element accumulates.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.
elements.authority: Obsidian interface + Working Memory filing only; Odoo/N8N/runtime/canon/Service/Method/Pattern/Asset/PPV mutation HELD

elements.name: Canonical Library
elements.role: the single agreed vocabulary and object model: canonical terms, definitions and their adoption state

mesh.enters: New terms, contested meanings and vocabulary collisions surfaced by any artefact.
mesh.interprets: Whether a term is new, a synonym, a collision, or a candidate canonical object.
mesh.structures: Canonical entries with state (candidate/adopted/deprecated) and lineage.
mesh.validated_by: Coherence checks against the corpus and Steward adoption decisions.
mesh.action: Record candidate canonical entries; publish adopted vocabulary to all surfaces.
mesh.observes: Where artefacts drift from canonical vocabulary in practice.
mesh.learns: Which definitions hold under use and which keep producing collisions.
mesh.asset_conversion: Adopted definitions become durable Canonical objects cited by every other Element.
mesh.feedback_to: Drift observations return to Canonicalise as correction Signals.

elements.purpose: Keep one agreed meaning per term so lanes cannot diverge on vocabulary.
elements.strategy: Canonicalise only after collision-checks against the existing corpus; never merge referents silently.
elements.assets: Canonical definitions, the object index and collision-resolution records.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.
elements.authority: Obsidian interface + Working Memory filing only; Odoo/N8N/runtime/canon/Service/Method/Pattern/Asset/PPV mutation HELD
elements.source: navigator/model.py (single-source model), deployed via Working Memory

elements.name: Asset & Pattern Library
elements.role: the register of reusable Patterns and qualified Assets, with explicit qualification state

mesh.enters: Candidate patterns and asset claims arriving from completed work.
mesh.interprets: Whether a claim is narrative, candidate evidence, or meets qualification conditions.
mesh.structures: Pattern records with qualification state, conditions and lineage.
mesh.validated_by: Qualification condition checks and Steward qualification decisions.
mesh.action: Register candidates; publish qualified Patterns for reuse by Compose.
mesh.observes: Reuse outcomes: where Patterns hold, where they fail.
mesh.learns: Which qualification conditions predict successful reuse.
mesh.asset_conversion: This Element IS the conversion gate: candidates become Assets only here, under authority.
mesh.feedback_to: Failed reuse returns to Transform as a re-design Signal.

elements.purpose: Accumulate reusable Patterns and Assets under explicit qualification discipline.
elements.strategy: One successful cycle is evidence, not a Pattern; qualification requires repetition, written conditions and Steward authority.
elements.assets: Qualified Patterns, Asset records and their qualification condition sets.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.

elements.name: Benefits & Assets
elements.role: the Benefit model and realisation ledger: what value each verb and Element claims, with evidence and realisation state

mesh.enters: Benefit claims and realisation evidence arriving from completed verb cycles.
mesh.interprets: Whether a claim is output, contribution, or realised Benefit.
mesh.structures: Benefit entries with baseline, target, evidence source and realisation test.
mesh.validated_by: Evidence-binding checks; realisation declarations remain HELD to Steward authority.
mesh.action: Record contributions; stage realisation candidates for Steward declaration.
mesh.observes: Whether declared conditions are approached over successive cycles.
mesh.learns: Which Benefit definitions are measurable and which need redesign.
mesh.asset_conversion: Realised, repeatable Benefits with stable evidence chains qualify toward Assets.
mesh.feedback_to: Realisation gaps feed back to Project as objective-setting Signals.

elements.purpose: Bind every claimed Benefit to evidence and an explicit realisation condition.
elements.strategy: Technical output is never labelled Benefit realisation; realisation is declared only when its written condition is met under authority.
elements.assets: The Benefit model (B1-B5), realisation conditions and the realisation ledger.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.

elements.name: Current Work Object & Queue
elements.role: the single current Work Object, the delivery queue behind it, and stream state including completed Stream A

mesh.enters: New work requests, priority changes and stream completion events.
mesh.interprets: Whether new work belongs to the current object, the queue, or a held stream.
mesh.structures: The 15-field Work Object contract and ordered queue entries.
mesh.validated_by: Queue-state consistency checks; Stream A remains ASSURED_STREAM_A_COMPLETE, never re-queued.
mesh.action: Advance the current Work Object; admit or defer queue entries.
mesh.observes: Throughput, blocked items and queue ageing.
mesh.learns: Which queue disciplines keep exactly-one-current true in practice.
mesh.asset_conversion: The Work Object contract format itself is a qualified reusable Asset.
mesh.feedback_to: Completion evidence returns to Benefits & Assets and to Orient for the next objective.

elements.purpose: Keep exactly one current Work Object visible with its queue, so focus cannot silently fork.
elements.strategy: Work enters the queue as scoped objects; streams complete and are retired as evidence, never silently reactivated.
elements.assets: Work Object contracts, queue projections and stream completion records.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.

elements.name: Context & Membrane
elements.role: the boundary layer: which Context work runs in, what crosses between contexts, and what the membrane holds out

mesh.enters: Inbound artefacts, claims and instructions from other lanes and external sources.
mesh.interprets: Which Context an item belongs to and whether it may cross.
mesh.structures: Context labels, crossing records and quarantine states.
mesh.validated_by: Identity restatement and hash verification of crossing artefacts.
mesh.action: Admit, quarantine or reject crossings; bind admitted items to Context.
mesh.learns: Which sources and shapes of claim need hardened verification.
mesh.asset_conversion: Stable membrane rules qualify as governance Patterns.
mesh.feedback_to: Verification failures return to Assure as systemic Signals.

elements.purpose: Keep every work item bound to its correct Context and stop unauthorised crossings.
elements.strategy: Everything crossing the membrane is inspected, labelled and receipted; nothing crosses by assumption.
elements.assets: Context definitions, membrane rules and crossing receipts.
elements.evidence_requirement: Every state shown on this Element's surfaces carries source, snapshot and freshness; claims bind to filed receipts.
elements.authority: Obsidian interface + Working Memory filing only; Odoo/N8N/runtime/canon/Service/Method/Pattern/Asset/PPV mutation HELD

verbs.controlling_question: Where are we, and what matters now?
